answer.text:
解:（1）设 $X_{k}(\mathrm{k} = 1,\dots ,1500)$ 表示第 $k$ 个误差， $E(X_{k}) = 0,\sigma_{X_{k}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{12}}$ 总误差为 $X = \sum_{k = 1}^{1500}X_k,E(\mathrm{X}) = 0,\sigma_X = \sqrt{1500}\times \sqrt{\frac{1}{12}}\approx 11.18$ 由独立同分布的中心极限定理，得随机变量 $\frac{X - 0}{11.18}$ 近似服从 $N(0,1)$ $P(|\mathrm{X}| > 15) = 1 - P(|\mathrm{X}|\leq 15)$ $= 1 - P(\frac{-15 - 0}{11.18} < \frac{X - 0}{11.18} < \frac{15 - 0}{11.18})$ $\approx 1 - P(-1.34 < Z < 1.34)$ $= 2 - 2\Phi (1.34) = 0.1802$

（2）设需要 n 个数相加， $X_{k}(k=1,\cdots,n)$ 表示第 k 个误差， $E(X_{k})=0,\sigma_{X_{k}}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{12}}$ ，总误差为 $X=\sum_{k=1}^{n}X_{k},E(X)=0,\sigma_{X}=\sqrt{n}\times\sqrt{\frac{1}{12}}$ .
由独立同分布的中心极限定理得，随机变量 $\frac{X-0}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}}$ 近似服从 N(0,1).
$P(|X|<10)=P(\frac{-10-0}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}}<\frac{X-0}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}}<\frac{10-0}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}})$
$=1-P(\frac{-10}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}}<Z<\frac{10}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}})$
$=2\Phi(\frac{10}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}})-1$
$\geq0.9$
$\Phi(-\frac{10}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}})\geq0.9=\Phi(1.645),\frac{10}{\sqrt{\frac{n}{12}}}\geq1.645,n\leq443.45$ .
所以，最多443个数相加可使得误差总和绝对值小于10的概率不小于0.9.

因为 $P(X = 0) = e^{-\lambda}$ 具有单值反函数，根据极大似然估计的不变性得，$P(X = 0)$ 的极大似然估计值为 $e^{-\overline{x}}$ ，极大似然估计量为 $e^{-\overline{X}}$ :

answer.text:
解:由 $X$ 表示在 $n$ 次独立重复试验中事件 $A$ 发生的次数，所以 $X \sim B(n, p)$。且 $p = P(A) = \frac{1}{2}$。所以，$E(X) = np = \frac{n}{2}$，$D(X) = np(1 - p) = \frac{n}{4}$。但是
$D(X) = E(X^2) - [E(X)]^2 = E(X(X - 1)) + E(X) - [E(X)]^2 = 5 + \frac{n}{2} - \left(\frac{n}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{n}{4}$。
由此，得方程 $\frac{n^2}{4} - \frac{n}{4} - 5 = 0$，即 $n^2 - n - 20 = 0$。
解方程，得 $n_1 = 5$，$n_2 = -4$。舍去 $n_2 = -4$，得 $n_1 = 5$。

$P(X + Y \geq 0) = \iint_{x + y \geq 0} f(x,y) dx dy = \iint_{y \geq -x} \frac{1}{4} dx dy = \frac{1}{2};$
$P(X - Y \geq 0) = \iint_{x - y \geq 0} f(x,y) dx dy = \iint_{y \leq x} \frac{1}{4} dx dy = \frac{1}{2};$

answer.text:
解:（1）X 的取值为 1，2，3，…，并且

$P\{X = k\} = P\{$前$k - 1$次试飞均未飞出房间，第$k$次试飞飞出房间$\} = \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{k - 1} \cdot \frac{1}{3}$
因此 $X$ 的分布律为
$$
P \{X = k \} = \left(\frac {2}{3}\right) ^ {k - 1} \cdot \frac {1}{3} \quad \left(k = 1, \quad 2, \quad 3, \quad \dots\right).
$$
(2) $P\{$这只鸟最多试飞 3 次就飞出房间$\} = P\{X \leq 3\} = \frac{1}{3} + \frac{2}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{3} + \left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{3} = \frac{19}{27}$.
（3）若将这只鸟是否“最多试飞3次就飞出房间”看作是一次Bernoulli试验，则这只鸟飞进该房间5次可以看作是一个5重Bernoulli试验.
$A = \{$这只鸟最多试飞 3 次就飞出房间$\}$，则 $P(A) = \frac{19}{27}$.
所以， $P\{5$ 重Bernoulli试验恰好成功4次 $\} = C_5^4\left(\frac{19}{27}\right)^4\cdot \frac{8}{27} = 0.3633.$
这表明:“假定这只鸟是没有记忆的”是合理的。

$$
F _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{c c} 0 & , y < \frac {3}{4} \\ F _ {X} (\sqrt {y - \frac {3}{4}} - \frac {1}{2}) - F _ {X} (- \sqrt {y - \frac {3}{4}} - \frac {1}{2}) & , y \geq \frac {3}{4} \end{array} \right.

answer.text:
解:构造似然函数为
$$
L (\theta) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f (x _ {i}) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \theta x _ {i} ^ {- (\theta + 1)} = \theta^ {n} \left(x _ {\mathrm{r}} x _ {2} \dots x _ {n}\right) ^ {- (\theta + 1)}
$$
取 $\ln L(\theta) = n\ln \theta - (\theta + 1)\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln x_i$.
所以， $\frac{d}{d\theta}\ln L(\theta)=\frac{n}{\theta}-\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln x_{i}$
令: $\frac{d}{d\theta}\ln L(\theta)=0$ ，得 $\frac{n}{\theta}-\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln x_{i}=0$ ，
得到似然函数的唯一驻点: $\theta = \frac{n}{\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\ln x_i}$
所以，参数 $\theta$ 的最大似然估计量为 $\hat{\theta} = \frac{n}{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln X_i}$

answer.text:
解:对于任意实数 t，由概率性质，有
$$
\begin{array}{r l} 0 & \leq P (X - Y = t) = P (X - Y = t, Y = a) + P (X - Y = t, Y = b) \\ & = P (X = t + a, Y = a) + P (X = t + b, Y = b) \\ & \leq P (X = t + a) + P (X = t + b) = 0. \end{array}
$$
而 $P(X-Y=t)=0\Leftrightarrow X-Y$ 的分布函数连续.
故选（B）.

answer.text:
解: $f(x,y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{cc}\frac{1}{4}, & -1 < x < 1,0 < y < 1,\\ 0, & \text{other} \end{array} \right.$ ，所以
$$
P (X + Y \geq 0) = \iint_ {x + y \geq 0} f (x, y) d x d y = \iint_ {y \geq - x} \frac {1}{4} d x d y = \frac {1}{2};
$$
$$
P (X - Y \geq 0) = \iint_ {x - y \geq 0} f (x, y) d x d y = \iint_ {y \leq x} \frac {1}{4} d x d y = \frac {1}{2};
$$
$$
P (\min \{X, Y \} \geq 0) = P (X \geq 0, Y \geq 0) \iint_ {x \geq 0, y \geq 0} f (x, y) d x d y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} d x \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{4} d y = \frac {1}{4};
$$
$$
\begin{array}{r l} P (\max \{X, Y \} \geq 0) & = 1 - P (\max \{X, Y \} < 0) = 1 - P (X < 0, Y < 0) \\ & = 1 - \iint_ {x < 0, y < 0} f (x, y) d x d y = 1 - \frac {1}{4} = \frac {3}{4}. \end{array}
$$
故选（D）.

answer.text:
解:总体 $X$ 服从参数为 $\lambda (\lambda >0)$ 的泊松分布，故 $E(X_{i}) = \lambda ,D(X_{i}) = \lambda ,i = 1,2,\dots,n.$
$$
E (T _ {1}) = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E (X _ {i}) = \frac {n \lambda}{n} = \lambda , \quad D (T _ {1}) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} D (X _ {i}) = \frac {n \lambda}{n ^ {2}} = \frac {\lambda}{n};
$$
$$
E (T _ {2}) = \frac {1}{n - 1} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n - 1} E (X _ {i}) + \frac {\lambda}{n} = (1 + \frac {1}{n}) \lambda ,
$$
$$
D (T _ {2}) = \frac {1}{(n - 1) ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n - 1} D (X _ {i}) + \frac {\lambda}{n ^ {2}} = (\frac {1}{n - 1} + \frac {1}{n ^ {2}}) \lambda .
$$
所以， $E(T_{1})<E(T_{2}),\quad D(T_{1})<D(T_{2}).$
故（D）正确.

answer.text:
解:（1）因为 $EX=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}xf(x)dx=\int_{0}^{+\infty}x\lambda^{2}xe^{-\lambda x}dx=-\lambda\int_{0}^{+\infty}x^{2}de^{-\lambda x}=-\lambda\left[x^{2}e^{-\lambda x}\right|_{0}^{+\infty}-2\int_{0}^{+\infty}xe^{-\lambda x}dx=\frac{2}{\lambda}$
所以由 $EX = \overline{X}$ ，可得参数 $\lambda$ 的矩估计量为 $\hat{\lambda} = 2 / \overline{X}$
(2) 似然函数为 $L(\lambda) = \prod_{i=1}^{n} \lambda^2 x_i e^{-\lambda x_i} = \lambda^{2n} \prod_{i=1}^{n} x_i e^{-\lambda \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i}$
取对数，可得 $\ln L(\lambda) = \ln \prod_{i=1}^{n} \lambda^2 x_i e^{-\lambda x_i} = 2n \ln \lambda - \lambda \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i + \sum_{i=1}^{n} \ln x_i$。
令其关于 $\lambda$ 的导数等于 0，即
$\frac{d}{d\lambda} [\ln L(\lambda)] = \frac{2n}{\lambda} - \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i = 0$
解得 $\lambda$ 的最大似然估计值为 $\hat{\lambda} = \frac{2n}{\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i}$，
所以 $\lambda$ 的最大似然估计量为 $\hat{\lambda} = \frac{2}{\bar{X}}$。

answer.text: 解:标准正态分布 $X \sim N(0,1)$，$\varphi(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} e^{\frac{-x^2}{2}}$，$\Phi(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{x} \varphi(t) dt$，$\Phi(x) + \Phi(-x) = 1$。因此，有 $P(X \leq a) = P\left(\frac{X - \mu}{\sigma} \leq \frac{a - \mu}{\sigma}\right) = \Phi\left(\frac{a - \mu}{\sigma}\right)$；$P(X \geq a) = 1 - \Phi\left(\frac{a - \mu}{\sigma}\right)$；$P(a \leq X \leq b) = \Phi\left(\frac{b - \mu}{\sigma}\right) - \Phi\left(\frac{a - \mu}{\sigma}\right)$；$P(|X - \mu| \leq a) = \Phi\left(\frac{a}{\sigma}\right) - \Phi\left(-\frac{a}{\sigma}\right) = 2\Phi\left(\frac{a}{\sigma}\right) - 1$；$P(|X - \mu| > a) = 1 - P(|X - \mu| \leq a) = 2\left(1 - \Phi\left(\frac{a}{\sigma}\right)\right)$。

由于 $X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{10}$ 独立，可见 $(X_{1},\cdots,X_{6})$ 和 $(X_{7},\cdots,X_{10})$ 独立，以及 $(X_{1},\cdots,X_{4})$ 和 $(X_{5},X_{6})$ 独立.因此
$$
\left| \begin{array}{l} \mathbf {c o v} (U, V) = \mathbf {c o v} (X _ {1} + \dots + X _ {6}, X _ {5} + \dots + X _ {1 0}) \\ = \mathbf {c o v} (X _ {1} + \dots + X _ {6}, X _ {5} + X _ {6}) \\ = \mathbf {c o v} (X _ {5} + X _ {6}, X _ {5} + X _ {6}) \\ = \mathbf {D} (X _ {5} + X _ {6}) = \mathbf {D} X _ {5} + \mathbf {D} X _ {6} = 2 b. \end{array} \right|
$$
于是，由 $\mathrm{DU} = \mathrm{DV} = 6b$ ，因此 $\rho = \frac{2b}{\sqrt{\mathbf{D}U\mathbf{D}V}} = \frac{2b}{6b} = \frac{1}{3}$

解:1）区域 $D$ 的面积为 $A = \int_{1}^{2}x\mathrm{d}x = \frac{x^2}{2}\Big|_1^2 = \frac{3}{2},$ 所以，而为随机变量 $(X,Y)$ 的联合密度函数为$f(x,y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}\frac{2}{3} & (x,y)\in D\\ 0 & (x,y)\notin D \end{array} \right.$ --3分2）当 $0 < y\leq 1$ 时， $f_{Y}(y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)dx = \int_{1}^{2}\frac{2}{3} dx = \frac{2}{3},$ 当 $1 < y < 2$ 时， $f_{Y}(y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)dx = \int_{y}^{2}\frac{2}{3} dx = \frac{2}{3}(2 - y),$ 所以，随机变量 $Y$ 的边缘密度函数为

$$
f _ {Y} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2}{3} & 0 < y \leq 1 \\ \frac {2}{3} (2 - y) & 1 < y < 2 \\ 0 & \text {其它} \end{array} . \right.
$$
3）当 $0 < y \leq 1$ 时，$f_{Y}(y) = \frac{2}{3} > 0$，此时条件密度函数为
$$
f _ {x \mid y} (x \mid y) = \frac {f (x , y)}{f _ {y} (y)} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 & 1 < x < 2 \\ 0 & \text {其它} \end{array} \right.
$$
当 $1 < y < 2$ 时，$f_{Y}(y) = \frac{2}{3} (2 - y) > 0$ ，此时条件密度函数为
$$
f _ {x | y} (x | y) = \frac {f (x , y)}{f _ {y} (y)} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{2 - y} & y < x < 2 \\ 0 & \text {其它} \end{array} \right. \quad 
$$
--10分

answer.text:
解:设 $X_{k}$ 表示第 $k$ 台分机请求外部通信信道（$k = 1,2,\dots,260$）.
则 $X_{k} \sim B(1,0.04)$，因此，$E(X_{k}) = 0.04$，$D(X_{k}) = 0.0384$，而 $X = \sum_{k=1}^{260} X_{k}$，由独立分布的中心极限定理，随机变量
$\frac{X - 260 \times 0.04}{\sqrt{260} \times \sqrt{0.0384}} = \frac{\sum_{k=1}^{260} X_{k} - 260 \times 0.04}{\sqrt{260} \times \sqrt{0.0384}}$ --4分
则 $P(X \leq n) = P(\frac{X - 260 \times 0.04}{\sqrt{260} \times \sqrt{0.0384}} \leq \frac{n - 260 \times 0.04}{\sqrt{260} \times \sqrt{0.0384}})$ $= \Phi(\frac{n - 260 \times 0.04}{\sqrt{260} \times \sqrt{0.0384}}) \geq 0.95.$ --8分
即 $\frac{n - 260 \times 0.04}{\sqrt{260} \times \sqrt{0.0384}} \geq 1.645$，解，$n \geq 15.5978$，即 $n \geq 16.$ --10分

于是 X 与 Y 的联合密度为:
$$
f (x, y) = f (x) f _ {Y | X} (y | x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} e ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - 2 x y + x ^ {2}}{2}}, - \infty < x, y < + \infty .
$$

$$
f _ {Y} (y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{2 \pi} e ^ {- \left(x - \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}\right) ^ {2}} e ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{4}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {\pi}} e ^ {- \frac {y ^ {2}}{4}}, - \infty < y < + \infty .
$$
即 Y 服从二维正态 $N(0,2)$ . 则 $f(x,y)$ 分布的概率密度形式为:
$$
f (x, y) = \frac {1}{2 \pi \sigma_ {1} \sigma_ {2} \sqrt {1 - \rho^ {2}}} e ^ {- \frac {1}{2 (1 - \rho^ {2})} \left\{\left(\frac {x - \mu_ {1}}{\sigma_ {1}}\right) ^ {2} - 2 \rho \left(\frac {x - \mu_ {1}}{\sigma_ {1}}\right) \left(\frac {y - \mu_ {2}}{\sigma_ {1}}\right) t \left(\frac {x - \mu_ {2}}{\sigma_ {2}}\right) ^ {2} \right\}}.
$$
对比 $X$ 与 $Y$ 的联合密度可得， $\mu_{1} = \mu_{2} = 0,\sigma_{1} = 1$ ， $\sigma_{2} = \sqrt{2}$
因此， $\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1 - \rho^2} = 1$ ，且 $\rho >0$ ，于是 $\rho = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$
故选（C）.

$$

E Y = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x, y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} e ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm{d} x = 0,
$$
$$
E Y ^ {2} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} (1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} e ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm{d} x,

$$
\rho_ {X Y} = \frac {E X Y - E X \cdot E Y}{\sqrt {D X} \cdot \sqrt {D Y}} = \frac {E X Y}{\sqrt {E Y ^ {2} - (E Y) ^ {2}}} = \frac {E X Y}{\sqrt {E Y ^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}}.

answer.provenance: 同科目、同年份原卷配套截图；显式题号映射及上中下顺序。选择题按答案字母或表达式对照选项。已对照题图：同为 X=e^Y 服从指数分布，求 Y 的概率密度，16 为连续题号。未完成逐题数学审校。
answer.text:
【解1】由于 $Y = \ln X$ ，应用求单调函数概率密度的公式， $Y$ 的概率密度为
$$
f _ {Y} (y) = \left| h ^ {\prime} (y) \right| \cdot f _ {X} [ h (y) ]
$$
其中 $h(y) = e^{y}$ 是 $y = \ln x$ 的反函数，$f_{X}(x)$ 是随机变量 $X$ 的概率密度，因此
$$
f _ {Y} (y) = e ^ {y} \cdot e \cdot e ^ {- h (y)} = e ^ {y + 1} \cdot e ^ {- y + 1},
$$
【解2】先求 $Y = \ln X$ 的分布函数 $F_{Y}(y)$，再将其对 $y$ 求导得 $f_{Y}(y)$。即所谓分布函数法，
$$
\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Y} (y) & = P \{Y \leq y \} = P \{\ln X \leq y \} = P \{X \leq e ^ {y} \} \\ & = 1 - e ^ {- e ^ {- y ^ {T}}} = 1 - e ^ {- e ^ {y + 1}} \end{array}
$$
所以， $f_{Y}(y) = \frac{dF_{Y}(y)}{dy} = e^{y + 1}\cdot e^{-e^{y + 1}}.$

$$

因此，Y 的密度函数为
$$
f _ {Y} (y) = n (1 - F (y)) ^ {n - 1} f (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {n}{\theta} e ^ {- \frac {x y}{\theta}} & y > 0 \\ 0 & y \leq 0 \end{array} . \right.
$$
$$
\begin{array}{r l} 2) E (\dot {\theta}) & = E (n Y) = n E (Y) = n \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} y \cdot \frac {n}{\theta} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y = \frac {n ^ {2}}{\theta} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} y e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y \\ & = - n y e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + n \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y = n \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y = \theta e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \theta . \end{array}
$$

所以 $\hat{\theta}=nY$ 是 $\theta$ 的无偏估计量.
$$
\begin{array}{r l} E \left(\hat {\theta} ^ {2}\right) & = E \left[ (n Y) ^ {2} \right] = n ^ {2} E \left(Y ^ {2}\right) = n ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} \cdot \frac {n}{\theta} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y = \frac {n ^ {3}}{\theta} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y \\ & = - n ^ {2} y ^ {2} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} \bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + 2 n ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} y e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y = 2 n ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} y e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y \\ & = - 2 \theta n y e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} \bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} + 2 \theta n \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y = 2 \theta n \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} d y = 2 \theta^ {2} e ^ {- \frac {n y}{\theta}} \bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = 2 \theta^ {2}. \\ \text {所以,} D (\hat {\theta}) & = E (\hat {\theta} ^ {2}) - [ E (\hat {\theta}) ] ^ {2} = 2 \theta^ {2} - \theta^ {2} = \theta^ {2}. \end{array}

answer.text:
解:由题意，可知本问题是在 $\sigma^2$ 未知的情况下，均值 $\mu$ 的假设检验问题，
$$
\boldsymbol {H} _ {0}: \boldsymbol {\mu} = \boldsymbol {\mu} _ {0} = 3. 2 5, \quad \boldsymbol {H} _ {1}: \boldsymbol {\mu} \neq \boldsymbol {\mu} _ {0}.
$$
取检验统计量 $T = \frac{\overline{X} - \mu_0}{S / \sqrt{n}}\sim t(n - 1)$
则当显著性水平 $\alpha = 0.01$ ，检验的拒绝域为
$$
W = \left\{\mid T \mid > t _ {\alpha / 2} (n - 1) \right\}.

解:随机变量 $X$ 的概率密度为: $f_{X}(x) = \frac{1}{2}\quad (1 < x < 3)$
对于 $1 < x < 2$ ，随机变量 $Y$ 在 $\{X = x\}$ 的条件下的条件概率密度:
$$
f _ {y \mid x} (y \mid x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{c l} \frac {1}{2 - x}, & 1 < x < y < 2 \\ 0, & \text {others} \end{array} \right.
$$
...2分对于 $2 < x < 3$ ，随机变量 $Y$ 在 $\{X = x\}$ 的条件下的条件概率密度:
$$
f _ {y \mid x} (y \mid x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{c c} \frac {1}{x - 2}, & 2 < y < x < 3 \\ 0, & \text {others} \end{array} \right.
$$
...4分
1）由密度的乘法公式，得 X 和 Y 联合密度 $f(x,y)$ :
$$
\left| f (x, y) = f _ {X} (x) f _ {Y \mid X} (y \mid X = x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{c c} \frac {1}{2 (2 - x)}, & 1 < x < y < 2 \\ \frac {1}{2 (x - 2)}, & 2 < y < x < 3 \\ 0, & \text {others}. \end{array} \right. \right|
$$
注:直接写 $f(x, y) = \begin{cases} 0.5, & 1 < x < y < 2 \\ 0.5, & 2 < y < x < 3 \\ 0, & \text{others}. \end{cases}$ 不给分.
2）随机变量Y的概率密度 $f_{Y}(y)$ 是联合密度 $f(x,y)$ 的边缘密度.
当 $y \leq 1$ 和 $y \geq 3$ 时，有 $f_{Y}(y)=0;$

对于 $1 < y < 2$ ，有 $1 < x < y$ ，则
$$
f _ {Y} (y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {1} ^ {y} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{2 - x} = - \frac {1}{2} \ln (2 - y).
$$
对于 $2 < y < 3$ ，有 $y < x < 3$ ，则
$f_{Y}(y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} f(x, y) \mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2} \int_{y}^{3} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x - 2} = -\frac{1}{2} \ln(y - 2).$
于是， $f_{Y}(y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} -\frac{1}{2} \ln(2 - y), & 1 < y < 2 \\ -\frac{1}{2} \ln(y - 2), & 2 < y < 3 \\ 0, & \text {others}. \end{array} \right.$ ...8分
3）计算得， $\mathbf{P}\{X + Y\geq 4\} = \int_2^3 dx\int_2^x\frac{1}{2(x - 2)} dy = \frac{1}{2}.$
...10分

answer.text:
解:似然函数为:
$$
\begin{array}{l} L (p) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} P (X _ {i} = x _ {i}) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \binom {x _ {i} - 1} {r - 1} p ^ {r} (1 - p) ^ {x _ {i} - r} \\ = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \binom {x _ {i} - 1} {r - 1} \cdot p ^ {n r} (1 - p) ^ {\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} - n r}. \end{array} \quad 
$$
取对数，得
$\ln L(p) = C + nr \cdot \ln p + \left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i - nr \right) \cdot \ln (1 - p),$ （$C$ 为常数）.…6分对 $p$ 求导，得似然方程:$\frac{nr}{p} - \frac{1}{1 - p} \left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i - nr \right) = 0$.解似然方程，得 $p = \frac{nr}{\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i} = \frac{r}{\bar{x}}$.…8分因此，$p$ 的极大似然估计量为 $\hat{p} = \frac{r}{\bar{X}}$.…10分

$$
f (x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} e ^ {- \frac {1}{2 \sigma^ {2}} (x - \mu) ^ {2}}, \quad - \infty < x < + \infty ,
$$

其中，$\sigma > 0, \sigma, \mu$ 为常数，则称 $X$ 服从参数为 $\sigma, \mu$ 的正态分布，记作 $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$
2）令 $Y = \frac{X - \mu}{\sigma}$ ，则 $Y\sim N(0,1),Y$ ，的概率密度为
$$
f (y) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} e ^ {- \frac {1}{2} y ^ {2}}, \quad - \infty < y < + \infty .
$$
则 $E(Y) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}yf(y)dy = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}} ye^{-\frac{1}{2} y^2}dy = 0.$
$$
D (Y) = E (Y - 0) ^ {2} = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} f (y) d y = - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} e ^ {- \frac {1}{2} y ^ {2}} d y = 1.
$$
因此， $E(X)=E(\sigma Y+\mu)=\sigma E(Y)+\mu=\mu$ .
$$
D (X) = D (\sigma Y + \mu) = \sigma^ {2} D (Y) + 0 = \sigma^ {2}.
$$

所以，随机变量 $X$ 的边缘密度函数为 $f_{X}(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{cc}\frac{21}{8} x^{2}(1 - x^{4}) & -1\leq x\leq 1\\ 0 & \text{其它} \end{array} \right.$
当 $0\leq y\leq 1$ 时， $f_{Y}(x) = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,\quad y)dx = \frac{21}{4}\int_{-\sqrt{y}}^{\sqrt{y}}x^2 ydx = \frac{7}{2} yx^3\bigg|_0^{\sqrt{y}} = \frac{7}{2} y^{\frac{5}{2}}.$

所以，随机变量 X 的边缘密度函数为 $f_{Y}(y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&= \frac{7}{2}y^{\frac{5}{2}} & 0 \leq y \leq 1 \\&0 & \text{其它}\end{aligned}\right.$
3）由于 $\mathrm{cov}(X,\quad Y)=E(XY)-E(X)E(Y)=0$ ，所以 X 与 Y 不相关.
 $f(x, y) \neq f_{X}(x)f_{Y}(y)$ ，所以 X 与 Y 不独立.

$$
L (\theta) = \theta^ {2 \nu_ {1}} \left[ 2 \theta (1 - \theta) \right] ^ {\nu_ {2}} (1 - \theta) ^ {2 (n - \nu_ {1} - \nu_ {2})} = 2 ^ {\nu_ {2}} \theta^ {2 \nu_ {1} + \nu_ {2}} (1 - \theta) ^ {2 n - 2 \nu_ {1} - \nu_ {2}},

$$
\ln L (\theta) = 2 ^ {v _ {2}} + (2 v _ {1} + v _ {2}) \ln \theta + (2 n - 2 v _ {1} - v _ {2}) \ln (1 - \theta),

$$
\frac {\mathrm{d} \ln L (\theta)}{\mathrm{d} \theta} = \frac {2 \nu_ {1} + \nu_ {2}}{\theta} - \frac {2 n - 2 \nu_ {1} - \nu_ {2}}{1 - \theta} = 0.
$$

$n = 15, \overline{x} = \frac{10.4 + 10.6 + \cdots + 10.7}{15} = 10.48, \sigma = 0.15, \alpha = 0.05, z_{\alpha/2} = z_{0.025} = 1.96,$
